static_capture_contracts.raw_before_parse: Static read confirms transport exact stdout/stderr Base64 and SHA are atomically written and uploaded before JSON parsing/scoring; no scientific oracle import in dispatch.
static_capture_contracts.invalid_provider_stdout: Non-object/malformed/nonfinite stdout is preserved; parsed record=null and capture_error, not a manufactured model response.
static_capture_contracts.planned_accounting: Frozen 64 job set fixed; no automatic CloudRun retries; each normal completion emits a row; forecast-stop emits explicit undispatched record=null stubs. Interrupted runner/upload loss still needs separate explicit unknown-capture accounting.
static_capture_contracts.offline_complete_guard: Frozen analyzer requires each planned job accounting row and exact protocol/request/rawrecord equality; missing accounting raises rather than silently reducing denominator.
static_capture_contracts.physical_evidence: Scorer requires successful current-round coder evidence for answer quantities/artifacts, actual successful numeric reviewer evidence and full answer inspection coverage; extra real current-round failed coder attempts may be inspected but cannot ground answers.
static_capture_contracts.future_completion_validation: Actual 64-attempt coverage, remote/local file hashes, stdout-row-aggregate equality, provider usage, drift and scientific scoring still pending retrieval of all original objects. This report is not that completed-capture audit.

limitations: Prospective protocol fixation is developer-exposed exploratory evaluation, not an external unseen holdout or contamination-free benchmark.

Official source URLs and fully specified scientific inputs are supplied; search plus document reading tests named-document acquisition and interpretation, not open-ended discovery or autonomous method selection.

Six selected family labels comprise four computational source families plus two clarification labels. Public methods and variants remain related; descriptive cluster bootstrap intervals do not estimate general scientific capability.

Matched global operation/time ceilings and explicit phase ceilings are not matched actual tokens, costs, solve time or guaranteed phase allocations. Global and reservation constraints can truncate phase caps.

Single author-context verification versus multi candidate-withheld precheck and fresh-context review differs in topology and precheck strategy; same Haiku model calls do not have certified independent errors.
Missing-input cases normally terminate in the common planner stage before reviewer topology diverges. Report 16 clarification attempts separately from 48 calculation attempts.

Automatic figure gates validate genuine received bytes, format and companion CSV values, not visible chart fidelity, axes, clipping, legend or scientific readability. Separate frozen rubric requires a human assessment; AI inspection is supplemental and not a validated replacement.
Actual hashed provider excerpts/read receipts and citation links do not certify complete-PDF extraction, source support for every statement, or absence of public-example contamination.

Cross-language oracle agreement independently checks numerical implementation; Cox shares the documented formula and does not independently prove assumptions. NIH MDE is a t-quantile approximation, not exact80%power certification.

Inherited application answer stores were removed from active runtime filesystem; parent image layers remain in history. Proof is not an exhaustive image-layer erasure certificate. Restricted R cannot traverse active app/workspace paths.

US$35 forecast is an investigator-selected pre-study model-token dispatch threshold, not a user hard budget or a bound on provider invoice/source fees. Outstanding runs can finish; any undispatched jobs must remain in all 64 operational denominator.

Known five engineering pilots were retained separately; the fifth completed after freeze. No further adaptive core/profile/scorer changes are allowed after freeze. Main scientific outcomes have not been inspected in this audit.

Git commit 5a78944 postdates launch. It verifies published evaluator bytes, not independent prelaunch registration. Frozen protocol/results files are not in that suite commit; their explicit hashes and launch/image evidence must remain available.
Provider and ordinary website traffic are not certified dedicated or isolated; randomized order and two repeats do not remove all shared-provider or timing variation.
